blocks.text: The module documentation defines hello/pairing, tool-call dispatch, and streamed execute-command behavior. It connects to the local workspace backend websocket surface.
blocks.title: Daemon connection responsibilities

blocks.text: _run_once opens the backend websocket, sends hello, waits for ack, and validates subsequent JSON tool-call messages. Bad handshakes or unknown message types do not become tool executions.
blocks.title: Connect, pair, and receive calls

blocks.text: execute_command reader-thread callbacks schedule WebSocket sends on the owning event loop. Send failures and an already closed loop are ignored so command execution can continue.
blocks.title: Threadsafe stream relay

blocks.anchor: async def _handle_tool_call(ws: "websockets.ClientConnection", config: DaemonConfig, msg: dict) -> None:
blocks.text: Malformed calls are dropped. execute_command runs in a worker thread with a chunk callback; other tools use threaded dispatch. ToolError and unexpected exceptions become tool_result failures.
blocks.title: Tool dispatch and final result

blocks.anchor: async def run_forever(config: DaemonConfig, stop_event: asyncio.Event) -> None:
blocks.text: run_forever resets backoff after a clean _run_once, otherwise retries network and timeout failures with exponential delay capped at 30 seconds until the stop event is set.
blocks.title: Reconnect loop

gotchas: Unexpected or malformed tool calls are ignored
A dropped stream chunk never replaces the final authoritative result
how_it_works: Connects and sends hello with pairing credentials
Runs other tools in a worker thread
Reconnects until a stop event is set
purpose: The daemon pairs with the backend and receives tool calls until disconnected. It dispatches disk tools off the event loop, streams execute_command output safely across reader threads, sends final tool results, and reconnects with exponential backoff.
summary: Runs the daemon's outbound WebSocket connection, tool-call dispatch, streaming output bridge, and reconnect loop.

params.desc: daemon backend, workspace, and pairing configuration
params.name: config

raises: connection, timeout, or protocol exceptions handled by run_forever
symbols.summary: Connects once, completes pairing, and dispatches received tool calls.
Schedules a tool-stream WebSocket send from execute-command reader threads.
Runs one tool-call request and sends a matching success or failure result.
Keeps reconnecting with exponential backoff until the daemon stop event is set.
